content.short: Stratum Exchange is the central liquidity hub for Mantle Network, providing deep token swap pools and routing infrastructure for the ecosystem.
content.description: Stratum Exchange is a decentralized exchange designed to serve as the central liquidity hub for the Mantle ecosystem, aggregating and routing liquidity from multiple sources to ensure deep pools for token swaps with minimal slippage. As a purpose-built liquidity layer for Mantle, Stratum enables both retail traders and other DeFi protocols to rely on its infrastructure as a reliable market foundation for the growing network.
